title: Diebus ac noctibus iniurias patiens ingemiscit.
html_source: Days and nights it [Creation] sighs patiently over injustices.

anchor.text: diebus ac noctibus iniurias patiens ingemiscit.
anchor.prefix: 5lifted, flooded and let fall. Lord, they are weary; and, whispered to, they sigh. Saint Ambrose heard it, sigh of leaves and waves, waiting, awaiting the fullness of their times,
anchor.suffix: To no end gathered; vainly then released, forth 1961#49flowing, wending back: loom of the moon. Weary too in sight of lovers, lascivious men, a naked woman shining in her courts,
anchor.canonical_text: diebus ac noctibus iniurias patiens ingemiscit.
